title: The index of board days
description: site-data/boards/index.json, in version 1 of the RisingRepos data contract. The contract's README.md, in the RisingRepos repository at src/risingrepos/publishing/contract/, says how the files are laid out and how the contract changes. Every field is listed here and no other may appear.

schema_version.description: The contract's version. It rises when a field is removed or changes what it holds.

board_days.description: Every board day that has been published, newest first, each once. Each has a folder under site-data/boards/days/.

board_day.description: The board day, as YYYY-MM-DD: the name of its folder under site-data/boards/days/.
